visualCharacteristics: Row of 3 product cards (1 col mobile, 2 at 600px, 3 at 900px). Each card: top image, title, description, and two CTAs (e.g. 'Get a quote' filled + 'Learn more' outlined). Bordered, rounded corners.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row = image cell + body cell (title, description, one or more CTA link paragraphs grouped into an actions row).
usage: Insurance/product cards inside the self-serve tab panels (Auto, Home, Life, etc.).
